CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_current_actor_tenant_presentation()
 RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id uuid, tenant_status text, name text, product_key text, enabled_modules jsonb, brand_theme jsonb, logo_url text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PLATFORM_CURRENT_ACTOR_TENANT_PRESENTATION_DENIED: Signed-in actor required.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT t.id, t.status::text, t.name::text, t.product_key::text,
      t.enabled_modules, t.brand_theme, t.logo_url::text
    FROM auth.users a
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = a.id
    JOIN public.tenants t ON t.id = u.tenant_id
    WHERE a.id = auth.uid()
      AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (a.banned_until IS NULL OR a.banned_until <= now())
      AND u.status = 'active'
      AND t.status = 'active';

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PLATFORM_CURRENT_ACTOR_TENANT_PRESENTATION_DENIED: Active identity and tenant required.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
END;
$function$
